The '''Cyax system''', also known as the '''Da Soocha system''', contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Da Soocha]], and its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Cyax]]. Seen from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] world of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], Cyax was one of the brightest stars on the sky,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the Hutts had many legends of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. For some reason, it was considered taboo by the Hutts, and they left the system unexplored when they left Varl,<ref name="TEA" /> and erased it from their astrogation charts.

During the campaign against the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Squadron]] was performing a patrol mission in the Cyax system when it encountered a target which did not broadcast any [[Transponder code/Legends|ID codes]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] moved to intercept the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] when its commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], identified it as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Defiance (MC90 Star Cruiser)|''Defiance'']] whose transponder had been damaged by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy during a recon mission in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].<ref name="SW:DEa">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>

Following the destruction of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Hutts expanded into the system, and settled particularly onto Da Soocha.
